title: 7 Things a Godly Man Does to Fight His Phone
caption:
7 things a godly man does to fight his phone. None of them are about wanting it more.

Delete the app instead of hiding it in a folder. Hand the password to someone who won't give it back. Filter the Wi-Fi at the router, not just the apps. Lock it away during the hours you're supposed to be working. Send your screen time to a brother every Sunday, win or lose. Kill every badge and banner. Decide what Friday night looks like before Friday gets there.

Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men (Colossians 3:23). Even the hour you didn't spend on your phone.

You don't win this fight by wanting it more. You win it by building a life too full of Him to leave room for the scroll.

Send this to a brother who needs a plan, not another pep talk.
